title: Margo host policy v1
description: Trusted host-owned capabilities and resource ceilings for Margo rendering.

schemaVersion.x-margo-security: Prevents interpreting policy bytes under another contract.

rawHTML.description: Whether documents may use the closed, canonical margo-html-v1 profile.
rawHTML.x-margo-security: sanitized enables only the versioned closed HTML profile; document metadata cannot change it.

inputBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 source bytes accepted for one document.

outputBytes.description: Maximum semantic HTML bytes produced for one document before page or artifact composition.
outputBytes.x-margo-security: Bounds semantic renderer output; final artifact limits remain sink-specific.

iframe.description: Optional authorization for canonical standard-HTML iframe embeds.
iframe.x-margo-security: Presence authorizes only the listed exact origins and target projections.
iframe.x-margo-interactions: Without iframe the natural iframe element is denied for every target.

allowedOrigins.description: Exact canonical HTTPS origins allowed in iframe src URLs; paths, wildcards, credentials, queries, and fragments are invalid.
allowedOrigins.x-margo-security: Exact-origin allowlist; runtime canonicalization enforces origin-only syntax.

sandbox.description: Sandbox capabilities Margo places on every interactive iframe.
sandbox.x-margo-security: Empty sandbox grants no iframe sandbox capabilities.

referrerPolicy.description: Referrer policy Margo places on interactive iframes and static links.
referrerPolicy.x-margo-security: Prevents source document URLs from being disclosed to embed origins.

projections.description: Independent output projection selected for each target.
projections.x-margo-precedence: host policy then least-authoritative target default
projections.x-margo-security: interactive authorizes a remote subresource only for that target.

interactiveProjection.description: Embed projection for an interactive-capable target.
interactiveProjection.x-margo-security: interactive loads the authorized iframe origin; static-link does not load a subresource.

staticProjection.description: Embed projection for a static target.
staticProjection.x-margo-security: PDF cannot authorize an interactive iframe.
